prayerExcerpt.en-US: Victor, a Christian officer in the troops, went about in the night-time from house to house, visiting the faithful and inspiring them with contempt of a temporal death and the love of eternal life.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Vítor, um oficial cristão das tropas, ia de noite de casa em casa, visitando os fiéis e inspirando-lhes o desprezo de uma morte temporal e o amor da vida eterna.

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman of Massilia of about thirty-five, weathered by service, with a fair, sun-reddened complexion and a strong, ANGULAR face — a broad, straight forehead, SHARPLY CUT cheekbones, the sides running straight down to a BROAD, FLAT-BOTTOMED chin with a vertical CLEFT; a SHORT nose with a slight BREAK at the bridge; deep-set, bright blue-grey eyes under thick, LOW, straight sandy brows; a wide, thin-lipped mouth; thick, straight sandy-brown hair cut short, a short, close sandy beard; the gaze frank and steady.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book tells the officer at Marseilles under Maximian, the converted guards, the kicked altar and the millstone; the Dutch and Belgian images on Wikipedia show a bearded soldier with a millstone, his traditional attribute. The fair, broken-nosed soldier's face is ours.
